touchTargets.rule: All primary touch actions use at least 48x48 logical units. Smaller visual icons must expand their hit area without changing the approved design.

typography.rule: Primary mobile reading text should target 17pt. Useful text must not be introduced below 11pt. Layouts must remain usable with larger text.

interactionLoop.rule: Every interactive control must close the loop: intention -> action -> feedback -> result or return. One tap opens or executes the intended function; a second tap is reserved for sensitive confirmation. Help text is collapsed by default and gestures accelerate actions but are never mandatory.

darkThemeReadability.rule: On dark backgrounds, functional text must use white or very light theme tokens. Muted gray is restricted to non-essential explanatory copy.
